cues: Every word of more than one syllable has one syllable said louder, longer and higher.
Some words shift it by job.
As nouns, record, present, export and conduct stress the first syllable.
As verbs, the stress moves to the second.
They gave him a present: a noun, so present.
The head will present the prizes: after will, a verb, so present.
The test is never the spelling; it is the job the word does in the sentence.
